players.product: 400G/800G/1.6T data center optical transceivers and 100G/200G PAM4 EML laser chips (via subsidiary Source Photonics)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, analyst meeting hosted by chairman Yuan Yonggang, board secretary Mao Xiaoyan and IR director Xiong Dan): the company regards the talk of a 65% US-origin material ratio as an unofficial market rumour, not an effective regulatory requirement. The optical chips in its optical modules are partly self-developed and self-made and are no more than 10% of a module's total BOM cost, and most other materials can be sourced to fit origin-ratio requirements. It already has capacity in Taiwan, which it says could qualify for exemption if rules change, and does not rule out building capacity in the US. It has received no customer inquiries specifically about the restrictions; customer demand is stable, deliveries are orderly and the rumoured policies have not affected current results. Its optical chips are mainly used in its own modules, with some external sales according to market demand.
quarterly_data.figure: optical chips no more than 10% of optical module BOM cost

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, analyst meeting hosted by chairman Yuan Yonggang, board secretary Mao Xiaoyan and IR director Xiong Dan): AI PCB demand is running above earlier expectations, with strong demand from core AI customers; previously announced capex projects are proceeding as planned and capacity will be released gradually. Its optical module (including optical chip) and AI PCB businesses both now cover mainstream AI cloud providers, and customer introduction has been showing results since it acquired Source Photonics.

Management (IR record, analyst meeting hosted by chairman Yuan Yonggang, board secretary Mao Xiaoyan and IR director Xiong Dan): global AI compute demand keeps growing, upstream core chip supply for optical modules is tight overall and the industry is in a tight supply-demand balance; 800G modules are the mainstream product and 1.6T is gradually ramping, with product value expected to rise as technology iterates. DSP supply is under control overall and it can prioritise delivery to core customers.
